other_failure_modes.name: Cross-Validation Data Leakage
other_failure_modes.description: Global statistics (such as imputation medians and frequency encodings) are computed on the entire training dataset before cross-validation splitting. This leaks information from the validation folds into the training folds, which can artificially inflate validation performance.
other_failure_modes.evidence:
med_val = tr_val.median() ... tr_clean = tr_val.fillna(med_val)
and
freq_map = tr_s.value_counts(normalize=True).to_dict()

other_failure_modes.name: Execution Error (KeyError)
other_failure_modes.description: The script fails during execution with a KeyError, preventing the generation of the final submission file. This is typically caused by referencing columns dynamically that have been either altered by the column-cleaning function or are unexpectedly missing from the dataset.
other_failure_modes.evidence: Process log shows: execution error detected; exception raised: KeyError; submission file not found

summary: The agent provides a sophisticated pipeline with proper out-of-fold target encoding, robust feature engineering, and ensemble optimization. However, it inadvertently introduces cross-validation leakage by computing certain dataset-wide statistics (medians and frequencies) prior to fold splitting. Additionally, the script contains a logical bug leading to a KeyError at runtime, which completely prevents it from producing a submission file.
